subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should the next Feishu plain-message card JSON fix require live Feishu proof before adoption, or may maintainers accept source/test proof for a narrow plugin-local parser?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but multiple same-shape PRs closed unmerged after proof/review gating, so automation should not create another fix branch until maintainers choose the proof bar or adoption path.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open and wait for a candidate branch or maintainer run that proves `message(action=send)` renders the card in a real Feishu chat.

options.title: Accept source/test proof
options.body: Sponsor a narrow Feishu plugin parser fix with focused tests and treat live Feishu proof as desirable but not required.

options.title: Retire raw JSON auto-detection
options.body: Decide that plain `message` card JSON is no longer supported and update docs to direct users to the structured presentation/card path.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and wait for a candidate branch or maintainer run that proves `message(action=send)` renders the card in a real Feishu chat.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin reference names this handle as the community maintainer, making them the best available owner for the Feishu-specific proof and support-boundary decision.
